sloka: ताम् उवाच ततो रामः शबरी संश्रित व्रताम् ।अर्चितो अहम् त्वया भद्रे गच्छ कामम् यथा सुखम् ॥३-७४-३१॥
transliteration: tām uvāca tato rāmaḥ śabarī saṁśrita vratām ।arcito aham tvayā bhadre gaccha kāmam yathā sukham ॥3-74-31॥

translations.english: Looking at Sabari who was steadfast in her vow, Rama said, O ascetic, you have worshipped me with devotion. You may go wherever you like (to the world you desire)
